scripts.clean:port: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process');try{execSync('taskkill /IM electron.exe /F',{stdio:'ignore'})}catch(e){}try{const r=execSync('netstat -ano | findstr :5173 | findstr :3001 | findstr LISTENING',{encoding:'utf8'});const pids=[...new Set(r.split('\n').map(l=>l.trim().split(/\s+/).pop()).filter(Boolean))];pids.forEach(p=>{try{execSync('taskkill /PID '+p+' /F')}catch(e){}});console.log('[Truth] Freed dev ports')}catch(e){console.log('[Truth] Ports free')}"
scripts.electron:dev: npm run clean:port && concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,VITE,DESKTOP" -c "cyan,magenta,green" "tsx server/index.ts" "vite" "wait-on -t 30000 http-get://127.0.0.1:5173 && node scripts/launch-electron.cjs"
scripts.package:win: npm run build && npm run build:api && electron-packager . Truth --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --icon=electron/icon.ico --out=release --overwrite --prune=false --ignore="^/(node_modules|src|server|tests|scratch|scripts|docs|public|release|test-results|\\.git)($|/)" --ignore="^/(tsconfig.*|vite.config.ts|index.html|\\.oxlintrc.json|package-lock.json|README.md|\\.gitignore)$"
